title: Gas City ingest authorization (Sam-authored approval artifact)

action.description: Authorizes ONE bead creation in ONE city. Never authorizes sling/dispatch/merge/deploy.

recipient.description: Exact Gas City name the ingest targets (e.g. designwins-staging). Mismatch refuses.

task_ref.description: Must equal the target finding's task_id. One artifact per task.

issuer.description: Only the human owner. Artifacts from any other issuer are refused.

authorization_ref.description: Human-traceable reference (directive, conversation, decision entry) explaining this grant.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds; expired artifacts refuse.

max_actions.description: Exactly one ingest per artifact. A second use must fail digest/budget audit.

payload_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical finding body it authorizes. Binds artifact to exact content.
